tools.name: cratejoy_get_store_metadata
tools.description: The store-level metadata record (id, store_id, created_at, updated_at, data: free-form JSON attached to the store). GET /v1/metadata/.

tools.name: cratejoy_list_customers
tools.description: List customers (id, name, email, country, location, num_orders, num_subscriptions, subscription_status, total_revenue). Filter by email or name, or with `filters` (e.g. { 'addresses.city': 'Austin' }). Relationships: addresses, logs, carts, notes, orders, shipments, subscriptions. GET /v1/customers/

tools.name: cratejoy_get_customer
tools.description: One customer by id, optionally with relationships (addresses, subscriptions, orders, shipments, notes...). GET /v1/customers/{customer_id}/.

tools.name: cratejoy_list_subscriptions
tools.description: List subscriptions (id, status, autorenew, billing_name, start_date, end_date, skipped_date, is_test, product_billing_id). Filter by status and end-date range, or with `filters` (e.g. { 'customer.email__like': '%@example.com' }). Relationships: customer, billing, term, product, address, orders, ship

tools.name: cratejoy_get_subscription
tools.description: One subscription by id, optionally with relationships (customer, billing, term, product, address, orders, shipments, logs). GET /v1/subscriptions/{sub_id}/.

tools.name: cratejoy_list_subscription_coupons
tools.description: Coupons applied to a subscription's next renewal (coupon_id, code_used, enabled, num_renewals). GET /v1/subscriptions/{sub_id}/coupons/.

tools.name: cratejoy_list_orders
tools.description: List orders (id, customer_id, placed_at, status, financial_status, fulfillment_status, is_renewal, is_gift, sub_total, total, total_shipping, total_tax). Amounts are in cents. Filter by payment status and placed-at range, or with `filters`. Relationships: customer, products, coupons, bill_address, s

tools.name: cratejoy_get_order
tools.description: One order by id, optionally with relationships (customer, products, coupons, addresses, fulfillments, transactions). GET /v1/orders/{order_id}/.

tools.name: cratejoy_list_shipments
tools.description: List shipments (id, customer_id, status, created_at, target_at, shipped_at, tracking_number, is_gift). Filter by status and creation range, or with `filters`. Relationships: customer, fulfillments, labels, ship_address, subscriptions. GET /v1/shipments/.

tools.name: cratejoy_get_shipment
tools.description: One shipment by id, optionally with relationships (customer, fulfillments, labels, ship_address, subscriptions). GET /v1/shipments/{ship_id}/.

tools.name: cratejoy_list_products
tools.description: List products (id, name, sku, slug, description, visible, listed, giftable, ship_option, ship_weight, has_subscribers). Filter by type or with `filters` (e.g. { 'visible': true }). Relationships: billing, instances, variants, subscription_types. GET /v1/products/.

tools.name: cratejoy_get_product
tools.description: One product by id, optionally with relationships. GET /v1/products/{prod_id}/.

tools.name: cratejoy_list_transactions
tools.description: List payment transactions (id, created_at, result: authorized/captured/failed/refunded, total in cents, is_test, order). Filter by result and creation range, or with `filters`. GET /v1/transactions/.

tools.name: cratejoy_get_transaction
tools.description: One payment transaction by id. GET /v1/transactions/{trans_id}/.

tools.name: cratejoy_skip_subscription_renewal
tools.description: WRITE: skip a subscriber's next renewal (action 'skip') or undo the skip (action 'unskip'). Requires confirm=true. Repeating the same action changes nothing more. This changes a merchant customer's subscription in Cratejoy; it is not this server's own billing. PUT /v1/subscriptions/{sub_id}/skip/.

tools.name: cratejoy_cancel_customer_subscription
tools.description: WRITE: cancel a subscriber's subscription in Cratejoy (the customer stops receiving boxes and renewals). This cancels the merchant's customer subscription, NOT this server's Pro plan (use the *_cancel_subscription tool for that). Requires confirm=true. A cancelled subscription can be restored with c

tools.name: cratejoy_reactivate_subscription
tools.description: WRITE: reactivate a cancelled subscription so it renews and charges the customer again. Requires confirm=true. Reactivating an active subscription changes nothing more. PUT /v1/subscriptions/{sub_id}/reactivate/.

tools.name: cratejoy_retry_subscription_renewal
tools.description: WRITE: retry the renewal of a PAST-DUE subscription whose renewal failed within the last 30 days. This charges the customer's saved payment method. Requires confirm=true. PUT /v1/subscriptions/{sub_id}/renew/.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: cratejoy_list_customers · Private data: cratejoy_get_store_metadata · Public sink: cratejoy_list_customers.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: cratejoy_list_customers · Private data: cratejoy_get_store_metadata · Public sink: cratejoy_list_customers

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
